Catalan

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Inherited from Latin adiūtāre (“to help”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): (Central, Balearic) [ə.ʒuˈða]
  • IPA(key): (Valencia) [a.d͡ʒuˈðaɾ]
  • Audio (Catalonia):(file)
  • Audio (Valencia):(file)
  • Rhymes: -a(ɾ)

Verb

[edit]

ajudar (first-person singular present ajudo, first-person singular preterite ajudí, past participle ajudat)

  1. to help, aid

Occitan

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Old Occitan [Term?], from Latin adiūtāre (“to help”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • (Niçard) IPA(key): [a.dʒy.ˈda], (Gavòt) [a.dʒy.ˈa], [a.ˈdʒɥar]
  • Audio (Béarn):(file)
  • Audio (Languedoc):(file)

Verb

[edit]

ajudar

  1. to help, aid
    Synonym: aidar

Old Galician-Portuguese

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

    Inherited from Latin adiūtāre.

    Pronunciation

    [edit]
    • IPA(key): /a.d͡ʒu.ˈdaɾ/

    Verb

    [edit]

    ajudar

    1. to help
      • a. 1284, Alfonso X of Castile, Cantigas de Santa Maria, Códice de Toledo, cantiga 5 (facsimile):
        Eſta ·xviiii· é como ſṫa maria aiudou · á emperadriz de roma · a ſofrer as grãdes coitaſ per que paſſou.
        This 19th is how Holy Mary helped the empress of Rome suffer the great pains she underwent.

    Portuguese

    [edit]

    Etymology

    [edit]

      Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese ajudar, from Latin adiūtāre (“to help”). Compare Asturian ayudar, Catalan ajudar, Ladino ayudar, Occitan ajudar, Spanish ayudar.

      Pronunciation

      [edit]
       
      • (Brazil) IPA(key): /a.ʒuˈda(ʁ)/ [a.ʒuˈda(h)]
      • (Brazil) IPA(key): /a.ʒuˈda(ʁ)/ [a.ʒuˈda(h)]
        • (São Paulo) IPA(key): /a.ʒuˈda(ɾ)/
        • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): /a.ʒuˈda(ʁ)/ [a.ʒuˈda(χ)]
        • (Caipira) IPA(key): /a.ʒuˈda(ɻ)/
       
      • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ɐ.ʒuˈdaɾ/ [ɐ.ʒuˈðaɾ]
      • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ɐ.ʒuˈdaɾ/ [ɐ.ʒuˈðaɾ]
        • (Southern Portugal) IPA(key): /ɐ.ʒuˈda.ɾi/ [ɐ.ʒuˈða.ɾi]

      • Audio (Portugal (Porto)):(file)
      • Hyphenation: a‧ju‧dar

      Verb

      [edit]

      ajudar (first-person singular present ajudo, first-person singular preterite ajudei, past participle ajudado)

      1. to help, aid; to assist
        Ajuda-me! ― Help me!
        Posso ajudá-lo de alguma forma? ― Can I help you in any way?
